title: finding(docs): `schema-reference.md` types `ObjectGridSchema.sort` as `string | SortConfig[]`, but a string sort is refused (objectui#8221)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site (class a): published reference docs teach an author a value the renderer refuses. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#5861 dev report (PR objectui#10533). The round-1 contract reviewer confirmed it at source; the seat recorded it on ACCEPT `5829037621`. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Site (read by the seat on `origin/main` at `90dbd1d31`)

- `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md:777`, the `ObjectGridSchema` property table:
  ```
  | `sort` | `string \| SortConfig[]` | Default sort configuration. |
  ```
- The declaration it documents: `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` types every grid-family `sort?` as `SortConfig[]` (~:757 and siblings).
- The renderer: `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:~117` and `~:2184` state that objectui#8221 (decision batch #77) retired the string form, and that a string sort is REFUSED.

⇒ An author following the reference writes `"sort": "name desc"` and gets a refusal. A `git grep` of `string | SortConfig` over `content/`, `docs/`, package READMEs and `skills/` returns only this row.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Make the row read `SortConfig[]`, with the objectui#8221 retirement named, in the same form the other retired rows in that file use. It is a docs-only change under `content/`, so no changeset.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18T15:37Z):
- `ObjectGridSchema` within 200 characters of `sort`, or `string | SortConfig` ⇒ 3 hits: the seat post, objectui#5861 and PR objectui#10533 (the origin);
- `schema-reference` near `sort` ⇒ the same 3.

Dedupe words: `schema-reference ObjectGridSchema sort string` · `grid sort row string SortConfig docs` · `8221 string sort documented`
